hypotheses.H0_shipped_gate_sufficiency: The shipped binary balanced-stoichiometry Flory-Stockmayer verdict is a SUFFICIENT network-adequacy statistic for role ranking across the admitted formulation envelope: (i) every certified pair remains gel-capable across the envelope stoichiometric tolerance, AND (ii) pairs at equal-magnitude reciprocal stoichiometric offsets are network-equivalent (extractable sol ratio within 2x either way), so the binary verdict loses no ranking information.
hypotheses.H1_reduction: Macosko-Miller reduces EXACTLY to the shipped Flory-Stockmayer gate at r=1 with monodisperse functionality, and its numerical sol-fraction bifurcation coincides with the analytic gel point.
hypotheses.H2_asymmetry_direction: sign(sol asymmetry - 1) = sign(g - f): the extractable-sol penalty of a stoichiometric mis-mix is borne by an excess of the LOWER-functionality component.

interpretation: RDKit re-derives epoxide and amine-hydrogen functionality for all 39 fixture records in exact agreement with the stored facts (rate 1.0), so the analysis is non-circular. H1 HOLDS: over 144 resin x hardener pairs the Macosko-Miller gel conversion at r=1 reproduces the shipped Flory-Stockmayer p_c=1/sqrt((f-1)(g-1)) to 0.0 absolute, and the INDEPENDENTLY computed numerical bifurcation of the post-gel extinction recursion lands on the same conversion to 0.0; 7/7 rows of the SIGNED prior receipt's gel table are reproduced. The generalisation is therefore a strict superset, not a replacement. H0 is REFUTED on part (ii) while part (i) survives: every one of the 68 gel-capable pairs retains gel capability across the +-5% envelope index tolerance (windows are at least 0.60206 decades wide), so the shipped gate is SAFE as a gate; but at equal-magnitude reciprocal index offsets of +-30% the extractable sol fraction differs between the two directions by 0.099304x to 7909.110104x, with 67/68 pairs off by more than 2x in one direction or the other -- a difference the binary verdict cannot express. H2 explains the sign and HOLDS: all 59 pairs with g > f are worse amine-starved and all 2 pairs with f > g are worse amine-rich (7 pairs with f = g are ties broken by the molar-mass ratio), i.e. the sol penalty is always borne by an excess of the LOWER-functionality component, which has no branch point with which to attach to the gel. For the canonical DGEBA + IPDA marine-primer pair the sol at complete conversion of the limiting group runs 0.0 wt% balanced, 0.098647 wt% at 30% amine-rich and 4.950978 wt% at 30% amine-starved (50.189x). Because every marine-primer-relevant pair has g > f, the zero-fitted-parameter directional design rule 'err amine-rich, never amine-starved' follows. Study 3 adds the mixture axis the per-molecule gate is blind to: the closed form y* = (C-f)/(C-f+1) matches numerical bisection to 0.0 and puts the monofunctional reactive-diluent ceiling between 42.363706 and 96.026646 wt% of the epoxy component depending on hardener functionality -- above which a formulation built entirely from components the shipped gate grades 'network_former' plus a graded-'non_network_former' diluent cannot gel at any conversion. Validation only; AUDIT_ONLY; no candidate, product, objective, manifest edit, or promotion claim.
